Name: TurmionKala's Hamsters as New Pets
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

Adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8304]TurmionKala's Hamsters [/url]﻿as new pets you can buy from Marnie! It doesn't replace the original vanilla pet sprites.

Let me know if there's any bugs.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img]
[/url]
Using the generic mod config menu you can enable/disable any sprites.

There should be no incompatibilities with other mods.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/94376493]TurmionKala[/url] ﻿for the original amazing artwork & the asset use permissions to allow the use of editing assets without permission (but with credit) in order to create this mod :)

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]

Downloads.Description:
Download and unzip into your mods folder



If you enjoy don't forget to endorse!
